title: Physically prune superseded repository branches
objective: Reduce the repository branch list to canonical workspace/project refs, the minimum rollback/legacy refs, and branches required by currently open pull requests or stacked dependencies, while preserving a reversible archive of every deleted branch head.
acceptance_criteria: Deletion candidates are an explicit audited list; newly created branches are never swept up implicitly.
Current open PR head/base branches and all canonical project branches are protected dynamically at execution time.
Every deleted branch head remains reachable from a single archive ref and is recorded by exact SHA.

The prune aborts before deletion if a candidate became part of an open PR, if a candidate moved after the audit cutoff, if another agent owns an unexpired active lease, or if the archive cannot be verified.
The final deletion executor requires the exact precreated archive lock SHA before it may archive or delete refs.
Only main, canonical project branches, required rollback/legacy refs, the archive ref, and live PR/dependency branches remain after pruning.
The one-shot pruning workflow is covered by a red-green contract test before merge.
Workspace tests and validation pass after pruning and after cleanup coordination scopes are released.
